items.summary: Maintain a bounded deferred launch pipeline. No new domains, spend, telemetry, deployment, launch, monetization expansion, or requeue is authorized while ownership, legal, security, measurement, release, rollback, attribution, and failure-repair gates remain incomplete. Preserve site briefs, templates, content seeds, SEO baselines, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklists, and launch gates as internal artifacts only.

Strongest candidate: elevatorfriends.com. Exactly one next step: reconcile its existing readiness artifact into a single site-factory gate record naming the owner, template/content scope, SEO baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness, compliance status, security disposition, rollback path, and measurement boundary. Do not dispatch implementation or launch until every required gate has dated evidence and owner sign-off.
